question: Does validation-selected decoded-prediction periodic reencoding improve absolute Allen--Cahn forecasting, and does the sparse recipe remain better than the exact dense tanh zero-sparsity control at physical times 20 and 40?
hypothesis: On three sealed datasets, the sparse recipe at its validation-selected cadence reduces H200 through-horizon field MSE by at least 5% relative to the dense recipe at its independently validation-selected cadence, and the direction persists in the H201--H400 extrapolation window.

scientific_distinction.direct: D(K^h E(x0)); exactly one encode; the clean test of autonomous linear latent evolution
scientific_distinction.periodic: Autonomous decoded-prediction feedback. At scheduled boundaries only, replace z by E(D(z)); no true future state is used. This is a nonlinear composite predictor and supplements rather than replaces the direct Koopman claim.
scientific_distinction.overfitting_test: Cadence-selection overfitting means a validation gain that fails on sealed test data. A sealed-test gain requiring frequent refresh is instead consistent with decode--reencode stabilization or limited repeated-K durability; it does not by itself establish parameter overfitting.

prior_outcome_aware_context.known_result: The exact same checkpoints have a 5.857% sparse H200 direct-rollout reduction on three opened new-IC datasets, 8/10 paired seed wins, exact one-sided p=9/1024, and paired-seed bootstrap CI [2.40%,9.21%]. Those datasets are excluded here.
prior_outcome_aware_context.historical_periodic_result: A 2026-06-29 three-seed experiment with different weaker models and T=4 found frequent refresh harmful and direct best. It motivates retaining direct in the grid but is not evidence for this packet.
prior_outcome_aware_context.outcome_awareness: Periodic reencoding was requested after direct results were known. This is a prospective same-checkpoint policy test, not a preregistered component of the original submission.

frozen_parent.checkpoint_roster: Exactly the parent's 20 hashed checkpoints: dense and sparse arms crossed with paired model seeds 64--73. No retraining, checkpoint reselection, averaging, or replacement.
frozen_parent.dense_control: The parent loader asserts encoder_kind=dense, lista_alpha=0, tanh convolutional and dense activations, and the exact full 2048x2048 K. The parent architecture audit verifies no sparsity loss or weight decay.

prospective_datasets.derivation_rule: SHA256 namespace; take first eight hexadecimal digits; bitwise-and with 0x7fffffff
prospective_datasets.collision_audit: All six names were absent from repository and scratch before freeze; residues 2715,5385,2961,7877,5089,9963 are unique and disjoint from all parent training/development/opened/reserved base-seed residues; every maximum stream is below 2^31.
prospective_datasets.generation_order: Generate and evaluate all validation data first; algorithmically write and hash the cadence decision; only then generate sealed test trajectories in the same GPU process. No human outcome access occurs between stages.
prospective_datasets.field_only: Serialized datasets contain fields plus neutral role/index/seed/shape/time/dtype/RNG metadata only. No basin/well/fate labels or counts are exposed to selection or forecasting.
prospective_datasets.storage_guard: Clone each dataset slice before saving; require storage_offset=0, contiguous layout, and untyped storage bytes exactly numel*element_size to prevent retaining the packed backing storage.

cadence_selection.period_semantics: At each step apply z=F.linear(z,kmat) and decode. Only after predicted times p,2p,... strictly less than the rollout horizon, replace z with E(predicted x). Direct has no refresh. Period 200 is excluded because it is prediction-identical to direct at the H200 selection horizon.
cadence_selection.implementation: Boundary-only segmented rollout. The encoder is never called merely to compute unused diagnostics. Encode calls are 1+floor((H-1)/p), or 1 for direct.
cadence_selection.objective: For each arm and candidate, average H200 cumulative field MSE equally over three validation datasets within each of ten model seeds, then equally over the ten seeds. Select exactly one recipe-level cadence per arm.
cadence_selection.tie_break: Literal exact minimum with no tolerance; exact ties choose fewer effective refreshes (direct first, then the larger numerical period), then stable canonical grid order.
cadence_selection.nonfinite: Every validation candidate in the frozen grid must be fully finite. Any nonfinite prediction or metric invalidates the packet; no candidate dropping, fallback, or finite-prefix selection is allowed.
cadence_selection.forbidden: No per-seed, per-trajectory, per-test-dataset, per-horizon, terminal-error, or sealed-test selection. No cadence changes after the selection-decision hash is written.

test_evaluation.evaluated_cadences: Evaluate the complete frozen nine-cadence grid for both arms on all three sealed datasets independently through H200 and H400. Sealed outcomes never select the reported policy. The H400 grid enables selection-aware durability inference by rerunning only the H200 validation selector and provides an accuracy--refresh frontier. Also evaluate p=200 only at H400 as an optional descriptive one-refresh-at-T=20 diagnostic; p=200 is selection-ineligible because it is identical to direct through H200.
test_evaluation.primary: Sparse at sparse-selected cadence versus dense at dense-selected cadence, H200 cumulative field MSE.
mandatory_secondary: Direct sparse versus direct dense at H200 and H400
Same-cadence sparse versus dense at each arm-selected cadence
Separately gated selected-policy H400 cumulative MSE
Selected-policy mean instantaneous MSE over H201--H400
All h=1..400 instantaneous and cumulative field-MSE curves
Persistence-normalized curves and late truth-change difficulty
Optional p=200 H400 diagnostic isolating one decode--reencode refresh at the trained-horizon boundary
test_evaluation.durability: The cadence objective remains H200 validation risk and is never refit to H400 outcomes. H400 and H201--H400 cannot rescue H200; they decide whether a gain persists beyond the trained physical horizon. When the full H400 grid is finite, arm swaps and paired bootstraps rerun the H200 validation selector to propagate cadence uncertainty. H400 remains an explicitly secondary durability tier conditional on the checkpoint roster and three frozen IC panels.

late_truth_language_gate.metric: Per sealed dataset, mean(H201:H400 one-step truth-change MSE) / mean(H1:H200 one-step truth-change MSE); the three-panel mean is descriptive only.
late_truth_language_gate.rule: Only if all three dataset ratios are below 0.05 is the panel called near-stationary, and H400 evidence may then be described only as attractor or pattern retention. If only a subset is below 0.05, active-dynamics language must be dataset-specific. This language gate never rescues or invalidates H200.

test_evaluation.strict_finiteness: Every validation and sealed H200 grid prediction, trajectory, field element, step, row, and metric must be finite or the primary packet is invalid. No finite-prefix averaging, nanmean, clipping, imputation, omission, or dataset replacement. H400 is evaluated only after complete H200. A failure in {direct,dense-selected,sparse-selected} suppresses the fixed selected/direct H400 tier. Any failure in the nine selectable H400 cadences suppresses selection-aware full-grid H400 inference and the complete frontier, but an unselected failure cannot erase an otherwise complete fixed tier or H200. A p=200 failure suppresses only that optional diagnostic.
test_evaluation.numerics: float32 fields/models with autocast disabled and float32 matmul precision high; float64 sums and reported metrics; F.linear orientation z_next=z@kmat.T.

estimand_and_inference.inference_unit: Ten paired model seeds. Average the three sealed datasets within each seed; trajectories and datasets are repeated measurements, not n=768 or n=30 inferential units.
estimand_and_inference.bootstrap: 100000 paired-model-seed resamples, seed 20260721. Each resample carries both arms' validation and sealed-test rows together, reruns the recipe-level validation selector, applies those resample-specific cadences to sealed-test rows, and yields R. Report the percentile 95% interval and selected-cadence frequencies.
estimand_and_inference.within_arm_policy_bootstrap: At H200 and, when the full grid is finite, at H201--H400, resample the same ten paired model-seed records, rerun that arm's H200 validation selector, and compare resample-selected sealed risk with direct. Report the selection-aware interval, seed wins, and cadence frequencies. This within-arm tier has no exact p-value; conditional fixed-cadence p-values remain descriptive.
estimand_and_inference.exact_test: Exhaustively enumerate all 2^10 paired model-seed arm swaps. For each swap, exchange dense/sparse labels jointly in validation and sealed-test rows for indicated paired seeds, rerun both validation-only selectors, and compare the studentized statistic using literal T_swap >= T_observed. Enumeration is exact; null calibration assumes a sharp null and paired arm-label exchangeability. Inference is conditional on the three frozen IC panels.
strong_primary_gate: all provenance, completeness, finiteness, and GPU telemetry checks pass
H200 selected-policy reduction is at least 5%
paired bootstrap lower bound is above zero
one-sided exhaustively enumerated arm-swap p is at most 0.05 under the stated exchangeability null
at least 8 of 10 paired seeds favor sparse
sparse aggregate MSE is lower on each of three sealed datasets
the selected sparse policy beats deployable x0 persistence in aggregate and on each sealed dataset
estimand_and_inference.durable_gate: In addition to a strong selection-aware H200 primary, the complete finite nine-cadence H400 grid must yield a positive H201--H400 selected-policy reduction with selector-rerun bootstrap lower bound above zero, selector-rerun arm-swap p<=0.05, at least 8/10 wins, no dataset reversal, and selected sparse error below deployable x0 persistence in aggregate and on every dataset. Any claimed H400 periodic-over-direct benefit additionally requires positive point reduction, selector-rerun within-arm bootstrap lower bound above zero, and at least 8/10 wins; no exact p-value is claimed for that within-arm tier. If only the fixed selected/direct subset is finite, analogous inference is explicitly conditional and cannot earn the stronger label.
estimand_and_inference.secondary_multiplicity: Same-cadence and direct contrasts are mandatory descriptive sensitivities unless explicitly Holm-adjusted as one predeclared family; none may redefine the primary.

interpretation_branches.direct_sensitivity_consistent: If the unadjusted direct-rollout sensitivity points in the same direction at H200 and H201--H400, report it separately as descriptive repeated-K consistency; it does not choose the primary branch or bypass multiplicity.
interpretation_branches.durable_decode_reencode_feedback: If selector-rerun within-arm evidence supports selected periodic over direct and sparse beats dense through H201--H400, report autonomous decode--reencode feedback consistent with stabilization; do not claim a uniquely identified mechanism.
interpretation_branches.frequent_refresh_dependent: If frequent refresh remains accurate through H400, call the nonlinear autoregressive E-circ-D-cycled predictor durable but refresh-dependent; do not call repeated-K Koopman evolution durable.
interpretation_branches.short_correction_dependent: If a periodic advantage passes H200 but fails or reverses in H201--H400, call it short-range correction rather than durable forecasting.
interpretation_branches.cadence_selection_overfit: Validation-selected periodic gain over direct fails on sealed H200 test: state that cadence selection did not generalize.
interpretation_branches.periodic_negative: Direct is selected or periodic is worse on sealed test: periodic feedback adds no deployment benefit; retain direct evidence.
interpretation_branches.invalid_or_ambiguous: Any primary incompleteness/nonfiniteness, interval crossing zero, or material dataset conflict forbids a strong claim.

hardware_plan.utilization_policy: Both disjoint GPU-compute windows independently pass every all-sample gate with zeros retained: the complete validation cadence-grid selector, and sealed-test CUDA integration plus H200/H400 evaluation. CPU initial-condition sampling, checkpoint/data I/O, and serialization are outside these windows. Whole-allocation utilization is also recorded descriptively. Run an exact-shape, outcome-free synthetic smoke before launch and audit that the GPU is the bottleneck.

outcome_free_smoke.workload: Instantiate both exact random dense and sparse architectures at dx=512,dz=2048, replace K by a stable 0.995I solely for finiteness, build three synthetic 256-trajectory H400 field panels, and run the complete nine-cadence grid plus optional p=200 with packed batch 768 and decode chunks of at most 100. This matches the scientific peak-memory and longest compute path. Before audit, derive the real PyTorch _CUuuid identity from its exact 16-byte value, validate its bare canonical string, and require equality with exactly one independently queried nvidia-smi GPU UUID through the same v3 helper used by scientific runtime lineage.
outcome_free_smoke.forbidden: No trained checkpoint, physical prospective seed, generated PDE trajectory, forecast metric, or outcome-dependent padding may be loaded or written.
outcome_free_smoke.gate: Use the same marker boundaries, all-sample utilization thresholds, cadence/gap/edge checks, and strict peak-memory fraction as the scientific run. After the smoke audit writes its receipt, invoke the exact v4 duplicate-safe Python guard on the GPU node using observed receipt/probe hashes. Externally pin those hashes before queue submission; the queue and scientific job independently rerun the same guard.

source_and_outcome_guard.outcome_quarantine: The GPU job never prints validation choices or scientific outcomes. It writes hashed selection and scientific payloads. Telemetry may read only metric-free runtime lineage and hashes. V3 runtime lineage repeats the smoke-tested PyTorch-byte/nvidia-smi UUID cross-check. A dependent summarizer may open outcomes only with an exact passing guard-receipt hash.
